proposed_comments.title: Isolate enumeration for normal CLI commands
proposed_comments.body:
### Isolate enumeration for normal CLI commands

**Severity:** `high`

The hidden worker protects the UI, but normal `FileLocksmithCLI.exe` commands still construct `RealProcessFinder` and execute the potentially blocking native enumeration in the CLI process. A kernel query hang therefore still hangs `--json`, `--kill`, and `--wait --timeout`, so the timeout cannot be honored. Route every normal enumeration through a contained child `--worker-json` process with redirected BOM-free UTF-8 pipes, a finite wait, complete stdout draining, and explicit failure propagation. Also cover a deliberately blocked worker and verify that no child is orphaned.

confidence.rationale: Normal commands still invoke the native finder directly, so a blocking kernel query can hang the CLI indefinitely.

proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: This concern requires coordinated changes across multiple current-diff regions or files, so it cannot be safely expressed as one apply-ready inline suggestion.

proposed_comments.title: Require the worker PID field

confidence.rationale: System.Text.Json defaults an absent non-nullable uint to zero, and arrays may contain null entries.

proposed_comments.title: Handle the native process-exit race

confidence.rationale: Process.Kill can raise Win32Exception when the worker exits between the check and kill call.

proposed_comments.title: Reject malformed process entries
proposed_comments.body:
### Reject malformed process entries

**Severity:** `medium`

A syntactically valid response can contain a null process entry or null file element. Validate the complete entry before constructing the UI model.

```suggestion
                    var processes = new List<FileLocksmithProcessInfo>(response.Processes.Length);
                    foreach (var processInfo in response.Processes)
                    {
                        if (processInfo is null ||
                            processInfo.Name is null ||
                            processInfo.User is null ||
                            processInfo.Files is null ||
                            Array.Exists(processInfo.Files, static file => file is null))
                        {
                            return MalformedOutput();
                        }

                        processes.Add(new FileLocksmithProcessInfo(
                            processInfo.Name,
                            processInfo.Pid,
                            processInfo.User,
                            processInfo.Files));
```

confidence.rationale: Null process and file entries can currently become crashes or invalid UI state.

proposed_comments.title: Treat invalid UTF-8 as malformed input

confidence.rationale: UTF-8 conversion occurs before the current try block and can escape the malformed-input path.

proposed_comments.title: Cover structured protocol failures and caller cancellation

confidence.rationale: Structured malformed JSON and caller cancellation reach branches not covered by the existing tests.
